item.title: The central question in American discourse , as long as America has so much power, will be how that power is used
item.description:
The central question in American discourse , as long as America has so much power, will be how that power is used. It would be beautiful to be able to have a divorced, abstract discussion about the use of force and specific details but that is NOT the discussion being had. The question is whether you think America should expand its v**lence against Palestinians or not. And to that the answer should be a resounding NO, and you should support Palestinians in enforcing that NO.
